shots.title: The Solmar Bank Job — dusk chase
shots.description: Dana in the armored van outside the Solmar Bank on Mission 6, wanted level 4, four police cars closing in at dusk — mission objective, minimap and HUD live.

shots.title: On foot at the Marina
shots.description: Dana on foot at the Marina Garage on Mission 1, the red sedan ahead, traffic and pedestrians around her, HUD and minimap live.

shots.title: Cracking the Bank vault
shots.description: Mission 6 in progress: Dana holds the armored van at the Bank vault dock while the crack timer runs and police close in under a 4-star wanted level.

shots.title: Title menu over the city at dusk
shots.description: The Solmar Heat title menu over the slow orbiting dusk camera of the city, with the story, the six missions and the controls.
